Bash(sqlite3 -header -column financial_data.db "SELECT year, SUM\(CASE WHEN STD_ITEM_NAME='经营业务现金净额' THEN AMOUNT END\) AS OCF, SUM\(CASE WHEN STD_ITEM_NAME='购建固定资产' THEN AMOUNT END\) AS capex, SUM\(CASE WHEN STD_ITEM_NAME='已付股息\(融资\)' THEN AMOUNT END\) AS dividend_paid, SUM\(CASE WHEN STD_ITEM_NAME='回购股份' THEN AMOUNT END\) AS buyback FROM hk_cash_flow WHERE stock_code='09987' AND quarter=4 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year DESC;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column financial_data.db "SELECT year, SUM\(CASE WHEN STD_ITEM_NAME='现金及等价物' THEN AMOUNT END\) AS cash, SUM\(CASE WHEN STD_ITEM_NAME='总负债' THEN AMOUNT END\) AS total_liab, SUM\(CASE WHEN STD_ITEM_NAME='股东权益' THEN AMOUNT END\) AS equity FROM hk_balance_sheet WHERE stock_code='09987' AND quarter=4 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year DESC;")
Bash(sqlite3 -header -column financial_data.db "SELECT * FROM stock_valuation WHERE stock_code LIKE '%9987%' OR stock_code LIKE '%YUMC%';")
Bash(sqlite3 -header -column financial_data.db "SELECT year, quarter, AMOUNT FROM hk_cash_flow WHERE stock_code='09987' AND STD_ITEM_NAME='购建固定资产' ORDER BY year;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column financial_data.db "SELECT DISTINCT STD_ITEM_NAME FROM hk_cash_flow WHERE stock_code='09987' AND \(STD_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%购建%' OR STD_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%固定%' OR STD_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%资本%'\);")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column financial_data.db "SELECT year, quarter, SUM\(CASE WHEN STD_ITEM_NAME='投资业务现金净额' THEN AMOUNT END\) AS inv_cf, SUM\(CASE WHEN STD_ITEM_NAME='投资支付现金' THEN AMOUNT END\) AS inv_pay FROM hk_cash_flow WHERE stock_code='09987' GROUP BY year, quarter ORDER BY year, quarter;")
